_comment: Section shard repos default to owner valerielinc-ops (see push-section-shard.sh). Sections listed here override the GitHub owner the shard repo/CNAME/deploy-key live under. A value is either a STRING (same owner for all 4 locales of that section) or an OBJECT {"default": "<owner>", "<locale>": "<override>"} for a per-locale mixed owner. Added 2026-07-27: uri/vaud/vallese moved to nanakokyobashi-rgb because their valerielinc-ops Pages https_certificate got permanently stuck in bad_authz (Let's Encrypt rate-limit hypothesis, see docs/AGENTS-HISTORY.md) and remove/re-add + 20min-wait remediation did not clear it. Deploy keys + SHARD_<SECTION>_<LOCALE>_DEPLOY_KEY secrets were regenerated for the new repos; DNS CNAME for origin-<section>-<loc>.frontaliereticino.ch retargeted from valerielinc-ops.github.io to nanakokyobashi-rgb.github.io. Updated 2026-07-28 (issue #4823 final verification): uri-it specifically stayed on valerielinc-ops (deploy key never regenerated for it there) while uri-en/de/fr + all of vaud/vallese are on nanakokyobashi-rgb — owner's explicit 'keep as-is, no further migration' decision. Without this per-locale override, uri's IT leg pushed against a nanakokyobashi-rgb deploy key that was never provisioned for uri-it, failing 'Permission ... denied to deploy key' and burning the IT leg's runtime past the fr shard's #2569 CDN-ordering wait timeout (issue #4846).
